tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return identity of the signed-in Lovable app user calling this MCP server.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.title: Get user profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in SMM app user's profile (id, email, client, claims). Agents should call this first so their suggestions can be tailored to the user.

tools.name: get_automation_settings
tools.title: Get automation settings
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's current SMM automation settings (engagement bot posture, notification channels, approval requirements, active platforms). Agents should call this before proposing actions so they respect the user's guardrails.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.title: List supported platforms
tools.description: Return the list of social platforms this SMM app supports.

tools.name: list_scheduled_posts
tools.title: List scheduled posts
tools.description: List the user's scheduled cross-platform posts. Scheduled posts live in the user's browser storage today, so this returns a descriptive placeholder rather than fabricated data.

tools.name: queue_cross_platform_post
tools.title: Queue cross-platform post
tools.description: Draft a scheduled cross-platform post plan for the signed-in user. Returns a validated post record ready to be added to the queue on the user's next app open.

platformIds.description: Platforms to publish to. Must come from the app's supported set.

tools.name: list_captions
tools.title: List caption library
tools.description: List saved captions from the user's caption library. Captions are stored in the user's browser today, so this returns a descriptive placeholder. Use `create_caption_draft` to add new drafts that appear next time the user opens the app.

tools.name: create_caption_draft
tools.title: Create caption draft
tools.description: Create a new caption draft for the signed-in user. Returns the validated draft record which the user's app applies to the Studio and caption library on next open.

tools.name: list_competitors
tools.title: List tracked competitors
tools.description: List the signed-in user's tracked competitors across all platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Reddit, Bluesky and more). Returns handle, platform, display name, status and follower count.

tools.name: add_competitor
tools.title: Track a competitor
tools.description: Start tracking a competitor for the signed-in user. Pass the platform (instagram, tiktok, youtube, twitter, linkedin, facebook, threads, pinterest, reddit, bluesky) and their handle/username. Write tools require user approval inside the app.

platform.description: Platform the competitor is on (e.g. instagram, github).

handle.description: The competitor's handle or username on that platform.

tools.name: list_rss_feeds
tools.title: List RSS feeds
tools.description: List the signed-in user's RSS automation feeds with their URL, poll interval, last fetch status, item counts, target platforms and errors. Use this before proposing any RSS-related action.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.description: List the signed-in user's recent in-app notifications (engagement, milestones, alerts, reminders, system) with severity and read state. Use this to check for alerts, sync failures or milestone updates.

tools.name: get_referral_status
tools.title: Get referral status
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's referral program status: their share code and link, lifetime referral credits earned, and how many referred signups have upgraded to a paid plan.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.title: Get AI credit balance
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's AI credit balance (remaining, monthly allowance, used this month, purchased) plus their recent credit ledger events. Use this before recommending any credit-consuming action.
